title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：meeting　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 meeting 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the organiser ① held the meeting that no resident in the centre would have recorded, and he said the holding was the whole of the month. The ② meeting, meaning the gathering itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a meeting, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ meeting in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ meeting at the far row, meaning the vote they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A meeting, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the organiser said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the meeting was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the gathering. The ⑥ meeting, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; meeting, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a gathering and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ meeting had become a line in a minutes, and the minutes had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ meeting of the whole thing, the organiser wrote in June, was one centre and three months of recording; meeting, he said, is either the vote at the far row or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ meeting I remember is the gathering recorded in the minutes, which closed in 1997 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ meeting, my mother said in 1999, is the only gathering that improves by being recorded; every meeting, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a gathering. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 会议；集会（指社区中心里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 会议；集会（指那次会议本身，与通知相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the meeting 召开这次会议
D. n. 会议；集会（指留给孩子们数的那一票那一次）
E. n. 议事之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的会议之事）
F. n. 会议；集会（指会议记录里写到、被记载的的那一次）
G. n. 意见、商量（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 商量（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the meeting that no resident in the centre would have recorded
The meeting, meaning the gathering itself and not the notice
the meeting at the far row
the meeting was the whole of the matter
the meeting had become a line in a minutes
The meeting of the whole thing
A meeting, my mother said in 1999

answers.why: hold the meeting 意为“召开这次会议”，1990 年那位召集人把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记载的一次会议做了一遍。
meeting 意为“会议；集会”，指那次会议本身而不是通知，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
meeting 意为“会议；集会”，指社区中心里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一张小小的通知。
meeting 意为“会议；集会”，指最远那排后排留给孩子们数的那一票那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
meeting 意为“意见、商量”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个意见就是那件事的全部。
meeting 意为“商量”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次会议，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
meeting 意为“会议；集会”，指会议记录里写到、被记载的的那一次，到 1995 年这一次成了会议记录里的一行。
meeting 意为“议事之事”，召集人六月写道，整件事的会议之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记载。
meeting 意为“会议；集会”，我记得的是会议记录里记载过的那一次，1997 年开完了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一次。
meeting 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，会议是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的会议。
